summary: Created a 7-phase implementation plan repairing all four extension-lifecycle-hook defects: object-schema resolver join, flat-deploy hook path resolution, an observable-but-never-blocking rc channel via SKILL_HOOK_LAST_* globals, and a live verification call site in command-gate-out.sh, plus nine regression cases, a creating-extensions.md addition, and a new all-extensions hooks-path lint rule.
